title: Integrate the Reward, Don't Sample It: Window Likelihood for Interruptions and Backchannels in Full-Duplex Speech Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.35581v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A full-duplex spoken dialogue model must yield when the user cuts in and hold when the user merely backchannels. Sequence-level RL with a timing reward (GRPO) is the usual recipe; we test its whole-rollout form on four open models and find two failures. A binary window reward gives zero advantage on exactly the windows that most need learning (a zero-gradient trap), and the one score per rollout is spread over listening-state decisions the reward is not written in terms of (credit leakage), so the model talks into silence or stops answering. Both come from sampling a reward that is a known function of a few binary control decisions. We propose \emph{window likelihood} (\WL): sample a continuation per window, but integrate in closed form over the stop decisions it visits and maximise the log-probability of acting correctly---a noisy-OR for yielding, a survival product for holding. On HumDial-FDBench, \WL\ gives the best yield/hold F1 on

translated_title: 积分奖励而非采样奖励：面向全双工语音模型中打断与附和的窗口似然方法
translated_abstract: 全双工语音对话模型必须在用户插话（打断）时让出话轮，而在用户仅作附和时保持说话。带有时机奖励的序列级强化学习（GRPO）是常见的做法；我们在四个开源模型上测试了其整轮展开的形式，发现了两类失效：二值窗口奖励恰恰在最需要学习的窗口上给出零优势（零梯度陷阱），而每次展开仅有的单一评分被摊派到奖励并未以其定义的收听状态决策上（信用泄漏），导致模型对着沉默继续说话或停止回答。这两种失效都源于对一个本可由少数二值控制决策的已知函数表达的奖励进行采样。我们提出窗口似然（WL）：在每个窗口采样一条续写，但对其经过的停止决策以闭式形式积分，并最大化正确行动的对数概率——让出对应噪声-OR形式，保持对应生存乘积形式。在 HumDial-FDBench 上，WL 取得了最佳的让出/保持 F1 表现。
tldr: 该论文发现基于整轮展开的GRPO时机奖励在训练全双工语音模型时存在零梯度陷阱与信用泄漏两大缺陷，并提出“窗口似然”方法，通过对停止决策进行闭式积分直接最大化正确让出/保持的对数概率，在HumDial-FDBench上取得了最佳的让出/保持F1表现。
